help.title: Caawimaad
help.start.title: Waa maxay Studio
help.start.body: Studio waa shaashadda guriga ee siddeed apps-ka CadCraft. Wuxuu furaa app kasta, faylalkii dhawaa ee dhammaantood hal meel ayuu ku hayaa, wuxuuna furaa fayl kasta app-ka akhrisa. Ma aha app sagaad: app kasta ayaa sidoo kale si gooni ah u shaqeeya.
help.open.title: Furidda faylalka
help.open.body: Dooro Fur fayl ama rid faylalka Studio. Naqshadaha waxay aadaan CadCraft, moodeelada BimCraft, kuwa kale app-ka akhrisa. PDF waxaa lagu eegi karaa MarkupCraft ama lagu cabbiri karaa TakeoffCraft, marka Studio wuu weydiiyaa oo jawaabtaada wuu xasuli karaa (Dejinta, Furidda faylalka).
help.recent.title: Faylalka dhawaan
help.recent.body: Fayl kasta oo aad furto ama kaydiso app kasta halkan ayaa lagu liistaa, kan ugu cusub marka hore. Guji mid si aad app-ka uu ka yimid ugu furto. Browser-ka, kaliya browser-yada xasuda faylalka (Chrome iyo Edge) ayaa isagu mar kale furi kara.
help.windows.title: Daaqadaha
help.windows.body: Fayl kasta daaqad gaar ah ayuu ku furmaa, sidaas awgeed naqshado badan ayaad side-by-side ugu furan kartaa. Badhanka Studio ee barta app kasta ayaa halkan kugu celinaya.
help.account.title: Akoonkaaga iyo naqshadaha daruuraha
help.account.body: Mar hal soo gal, app kasta ayuu naqshadahaaga daruuraha furi karaa oo kaydin karaa. Studio kood gaaban ayuu tusaa; ansixi getcadcraft.com/device. Marka khadka ka baxsan tahay, kaydinta waxay ku sugaysaa kombiyuutarkan oo markii xiriirku soo noqdo ayay diraan; kaydin waligeed nooc cusub ma qori.
help.assistants.title: Ku xidhida caawiye
help.assistants.body: Caawiye AI ayaa naqshadahaaga ku shaqayn kara Studio (desktop) dhexdiisa. Fur app, ka dibna Dejinta › Caawiyeyaasha ku dhaji, oo dooro waxa uu samayn karo. Kaadhka Ku xidh caawiye ayaa markaas tusaya cinwaan kombiyuutarkan kaliya shaqeeya, token, iyo dejinta lagu dhejiyo caawiyahaaga. Token-ka qarsoon hay. Token cusub wuxuu saxiixaa caawiyeyaal kasta; Ka jooji dhammaan wuxuu joojiyaa fadhiyadooda.
help.offline.title: Shaqada khadka ka baxsan
help.offline.body: Studio iyo apps-ku kombiyuutarkaaga ayay ku shaqeeyaan. Wax aad furto looma soo dirin, mooyaane haddii aad daruuraha ku kaydiso.
help.updates.title: Rakibid iyo cusboonaysiin
help.updates.body: Studio u soo deji nidaamkaaga getcadcraft.com/download. Dejinta › Cusboonaysiinta waxay tusaa nooca iyo nooca-nuqulkaaga, cusboonaysiinta meesha ka timaadaa, markii ugu dambaysay ee Studio hubiyay, iyo nooca ugu cusub ee nooca-nuqulkaaga iyo waxa cusub ku jira. “Hubi cusboonaysiinta” wuu raadiyaa nooc cusub wuxuuna weli weydiiyaa ka hor intuusan wax rakibin; “Si toos ah u hubi” ayaa bilowga la shidan yahay wuxuuna hal mar maalin hubiyaa; haddii aad doonto demi. Cusboonaysiinta waxay rakibaysaa kaliya haddii ay saxiixa CadCraft leedahay. Installer-ka Windows, Linux .deb iyo AppImage getcadcraft.com ayay ka cusboonaysiiyaan; zip-ka portable-ka kaliya ayuu kuu sheegaa marka zip cusub soo baxo (soo dejiso oo folderka xogtaada geli). Package-ka Windows ee getcadcraft.com wuxuu ka cusboonaysiiyaa Windows App Installer, nuqulka Microsoft Store-na Store-ka; Studio Hubi cusboonaysiinta labadaba wuxuu weydiisaa Windows. Dhismayaasha dukaamada kale (App Store, Google Play) dukaankaas ayay ka cusboonaysiiyaan. Nuqulka browser-ka folderkiisa waxa lagu beddelaa mid cusub. Haddii sii deynta ugu dambaysa nidaamkaaga fayl uusan weli lahayn, hubintu way sheegtaa halkii ay fashilmi lahayd. Linux, Studio wuxuu damiyaa jidka grafikada ee daaqadda madow ka dhigi karta qaar ka mid ah drivers-ka; WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER aad dejisay waxay ahaan doontaa sidaad dejisay.

help.live.title: Live TeamWork
help.live.body: Fur fayl app kasta oo ku jira, dooro Live badhanka uu leeyahay, ka dibna Wadaag. Dadka isla shabakadda ku jira waxay ku biiraan koodhka uu Studio muujiyo (ama iyagoo sawirka scan gareeya); qofka meel kale joogaa, samee xiriiriye casuumaad. Qof kasta waad ansixisaa, isagoo ah Tafatir ama Eeg kaliya. Dadka oo dhan isbedelada waxay arkaan markay dhacaan, isbedeladaadana ma sugaan kuwa kale. Dib u noqo wuxuu dib u noqdaa kaliya shaqadaada. Martiqaadu keliya ayaa kaydiya faylka; kalfadhigu markuu dhammaado, qofka kale walba wuxuu haysanayaa nuqul aan la kaydin. Kalfadhiga shabakaddaada gudaheeda waa bilaash; xiriiriyeyaasha casuumaadda internetka ku dhex maraya waxay u baahan yihiin shat ganacsi oo app-ka ah, marti waxba uma baahna. Si aad ugu biirto, isticmaal Ku biir kalfadhi toosan halkan.

window.machines.title: Mashiinnada
window.machines.lead: Daabacayaasha, mashiinnada CNC iyo laser-yada shabakadaada gudaheeda. Shaqo waxaa lagu soo rarayaa mashiinka; daabacaha kaliya ayaa halkan laga bilaabi karaa, markaad xaqiijiso inaad joogto.
window.machines.add.title: Ku dar mashiin
window.machines.add.public: Cinwaankaas shabakadaada gudaha ma ku jiro. Isticmaal cinwaanka mashiinka guriga ama shaqada, sida 192.168.1.40 ama printer.local.
window.machines.add.bad: Taasi maaha mashiin Studio la hadli karo.
window.machines.name: Magaca
window.machines.test.fail: Lama gaari karo. Hubi cinwaanka, in uu shidan yahay, iyo furaha.
window.machines.key.saved: Furaha kumbuyuutarkan ayaa lagu kaydiyay. Mar kale looma muuji karo.
window.machines.safety: Mashiin CNC, laser ama robot Studio ma bilaabato: faylka ayaa mashiinka gaaraya, halkaas ayaad ka bilaabtaa.
window.machines.send.title: U dir mashiin
window.machines.send.none: Mashiin nooca noocan ah lama dejin. Ku dar mid Studio gudihiisa Mashiinnada hoosteeda.
window.machines.send.start: Bilow shaqada kadib markii la soo rarayo
window.machines.send.sure: Waxaan joogaa mashiinka oo waa nadiif
window.machines.send.nostart: Nooca mashiinkan Studio ma bilaabato. Faylka waa la soo rarayaa; halkaas ka bilow.
window.machines.err.name: Faylku wuxuu u baahan yahay magac G-code ama NC, sida part.gcode ama beam.nc1.
window.machines.err.network: Mashiinka lama gaari karo. Ma shidan yahay oo shabakaddan ku jiraa?
standards.title: Heerarka shirkadda
standards.lead: Xeerarka guriga shirkaddaadu mar keliya qor, ama fayl soo geli. Dhammaan AI-ga aad xiriirtid ayaa akhrin doona: magacyada layer-ka iyo faylalka, erayada aad isticmaasho, iyo hubinta ay naqshaddu gudbi lahayd. Weligood ma siiyaan AI wax ka badan wixii aad oggolaatay.
standards.will: Kuwani waa xeerarka AI kasta akhrin doonto ({firm}, nooca {revision}, {updated}). Ka hor intaadan kaydin, akhri, gaar ahaan fayl ka yimid qof kale.
activity.title: Waxa caawiyayaashaadu sameeyeen
activity.lead: App AI kasta oo aad xiriirto, erey fudud: wixii akhriyay, socodsiiyay iyo wixii beddelay, daaqad kasta. Liiska soo dhoofi haddii shirkaddu rikoor u baahan tahay. Isbeddel ka noqo appkaas, adigoo isticmaalaya Ka noqo.
activity.none: Weli waxba. Liiskan wuu buuxmayaa markii caawiye app isticmaalo.
